symptom: Higgs3 original8188 inference loaded weights but worker failed on progress-bar UnicodeEncodeError
root_cause: Embedded Python -I ignores PYTHONIOENCODING and redirected stdout retained cp949
fix: Reconfigure worker stdout and stderr explicitly to UTF-8 before model imports
prevention: Set stream encoding in isolated worker itself; do not rely only on inherited PYTHONIOENCODING under -I
